sources.title: Jwuthri/SelfJev - GitHub
sources.snippet: The eval_* families were written and blind-verified by Claude Opus. GPT-6 Astra scores 100% on all seven and Jev 92-100% on six of them, so these families separate small models from frontier ones rather than frontier models from each other. On noisy-label public sets (GoEmotions, TweetEval, dair-ai emotion) every model stays well below 100%.

It was released in limited early access on 15 September 2026, alongside the announcement of a US$40 million seed round led by DCVC.
